scope: Reapproval-based folder-access archive recovery in sandbox development builds
cause: remember() previously loaded the entire archive before saving a fresh approval, so archive corruption prevented the user from reapproving a folder.
implemented: Validate and activate fresh folder authority before archive changes
Salvage structurally valid version-1 records while excluding conflicting duplicates
Preserve exact damaged bytes in an exclusive private backup before replacement
Bounded no-follow reads and per-role writer leases
Single atomic publication for each received grant batch
Refuse recognizable unsupported formats with a distinct compatibility notice
Renew stale bookmarks without overwriting a newer disk record
Balance scope lifetimes on failed and successful batches

releaseApplication.method: Swift type-check only; sandbox code excluded

limitations: Unresolvable bookmarks remain stored but do not authorize access while unresolved.
Unreadable archive structures cannot supply inferred approvals; required folders must be reapproved.
Oversized, unsafe, inaccessible and recognizable unsupported-format archives are not rewritten.
Failed backup creation prevents active archive replacement; a later publication-durability failure can occur after atomic replacement.
Backups are retained privately without automatic pruning or cross-executable restore.
pending: Exact backup-byte and corruption recovery acceptance
Unknown formats, empty batches and invalid incoming grants
Failed backup, rename/sync interruption and disk-space behavior
Concurrent writers, stale renewals and balanced security-scope lifetimes
